card.name: Where the reverse interaction comes next
card.fires_on: Words in drug-interaction text where the sentence is about to turn to the opposite direction, such as the effect of drug B on drug A after drug A on B. It also fires on the "be" in "to love and to be loved" and on linking words before a reversed relationship.
